readerCopy.body: Moving forward can require less disruption than expected when the new direction actually fits the needs of ordinary life. When the Moon trines the North Node, care, routine, and forward movement reinforce each other, making home, family, sleep, food, and practical support part of what helps the plan work. The direction can feel more viable precisely because daily life does not have to be sacrificed to maintain it. A future worth building benefits from being livable in the present too.
